channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Charleaux: atitude de Lula sobre maioridade equivale a Flávio com 6x1
item.description: João Paulo Charleaux criticized Lula for supporting lowering the age of criminal responsibility to 16, comparing the stance to Flávio Bolsonaro's retreat on the 6x1 scale during a Globo interview.

item.title: Na Globo, Lula erra dado de empregos e exagera sobre partidos no governo
item.description: In a Globo interview, President Lula made errors regarding job creation figures during his terms and exaggerated when describing the party composition in his government. The inaccuracies drew criticism from analysts, raising concerns about campaign messaging accuracy.

item.title: Campanha de Lula relata à OEA e UE suposta assimetria da Meta na eleição
item.description: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's campaign reported to international election observation missions that Meta's tools treated content and ads unevenly during the electoral period, raising concerns about potential impacts on election transparency. The information was shared with the Organization of American States (OAS) and the European Union (EU).

item.title: Apoiadores realizam ato pró-Lula nas ruas centrais de Apucarana
item.description: Supporters of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva held a pro-campaign rally in Apucarana, using flags and posters to back his re-election bid. The event took place Thursday night.

item.title: Marina Sena promete performance visceral no Estilo Brasil, em Brasília
item.description: Marina Sena will perform at the Estilo Brasil Festival in Brasília on November 19, bringing a theatrical and visceral performance that blends music, theater, and artistic expression. Her artistic trajectory has become increasingly experimental, featuring striking scenes such as the destruction of a rag doll during 'Ouro de Tolo,' interpreted as a critique of patriarchy. The artist seeks to expand the boundaries of performance by connecting body, light, dance, and scenography in her songs' narrative.

item.title: "Gostoso da Esplanada" reage a vídeo viral em ato: “O importante é a pauta”
item.description: The 20-year-old known as 'Gostoso da Esplanada' went viral after appearing shirtless at a pro-Lula rally in Brasília, but emphasized that the focus should be on the political agenda, not his image. He noted that humor and unusual visuals attract young people to political discussions, but this attention must translate into genuine interest in the movement's demands. The video was filmed at a photographer's request and was not part of his plans.

item.title: Eleições 2026: confira as agendas de Flávio e Lula nesta sexta (16/10)
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula carry out campaign commitments for the 2026 election runoff. Flávio secured 47.03% of valid votes, while Lula received 45.16%, advancing to the October 25th ballot. Both teams announce campaign schedules across various Brazilian states.

item.title: Com presença de Lula, Congresso promulga fim da 6x1 nesta sexta-feira
item.description: The National Congress will promulgate on Friday (10/16) the constitutional amendment that ends the 6x1 work schedule in Brazil, allowing reduction from 44 to 42 hours per week in December and 40 hours the following year. The measure, approved in the Senate with 75 votes, is one of Lula's main bets in his reelection campaign.

item.title: Brasileirão: Mirassol e Internacional duelam na luta contra o rebaixamento
item.description: In the 31st round of the 2026 Brazilian Championship, Mirassol and Internacional face each other in a direct relegation battle match, with Mirassol in 15th place (33 points) and Internacional in 17th (32 points). Both teams need points to avoid relegation.

item.title: Fim da escala 6x1: entenda o que diz o texto e a regra de transição
item.description: Congress approves the pension reform amendment ending the 6x1 work schedule, gradually reducing the weekly work hours from 44 to 40. The rule establishes two paid weekly rest days and allows compensatory regimes through collective agreements. President Lula's re-election is aided by the approval of one of his electoral slogans.

item.title: Com rua cheia e medidas, Lula não sai do lugar
item.description: Protests by youth and left-wing influencers did not impact Lula's polling numbers, who maintained his position. The campaign used strategies such as selfie videos and pen exchanges, but without major changes in voting intentions.

item.title: O caso Meta e a disputa no TSE em torno das redes sociais - O Assunto #1826
item.description: The TSE ruled that Meta cannot interfere in political-electoral content distribution after Lula's campaign sued over boosted posts supporting Flávio Bolsonaro. Minister Marco Aurélio Bellizze imposed a daily fine of R$ 500,000, while experts debate social media regulation limits during campaigns.

item.title: Veja o que é #FATO ou #FAKE na entrevista de Lula à Globo no 2º turno das eleições 2026
item.description: Lula was interviewed by Globo following the first phase of the second round of the 2026 elections, where he commented on recent PF operations involving allies of Flávio Bolsonaro, such as Márcio Canella. The statement was verified as #FACT, as Canella was arrested in the 'Unha e Carne' operation, investigated for crimes like money laundering and cartel formation.

item.title: Entrevista de Flávio Bolsonaro na Globo: veja quando e onde assistir
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, presidential candidate from PL, will be interviewed by TV Globo this Friday (16), following the nightly news. The interview, hosted by Renata Lo Prete, will be live at Globo Studios and simulcast on GloboNews and g1.

item.title: Primeira Turma do STF começa a julgar nesta sexta denúncia e pode tornar réu blogueiro aliado de Bolsonaro
item.description: The First Chamber of the STF begins a virtual trial to decide whether blogger Oswaldo Eustáquio, an ally of Bolsonaro, becomes a defendant for criminal association linked to posts and demonstrations against the Lula government and the electoral system. The defense claims the process is being held in absentia and without due process, while Eustáquio has preventive arrest warrants in Brazil.

item.title: Quando será o segundo turno das eleições 2026? Veja a data
item.description: The second round of the 2026 elections is scheduled for Sunday, October 25, with voting from 8am to 5pm BRT. States such as Rondônia, Mato Grosso and Amazonas start at 7am, while Fernando de Noronha begins at 9am. The TSE urges all voters to go to the polls.

item.title: México tenta mostrar que segurança não pode ser um monopólio da direita
item.description: Mexico seeks to show that security should not be a monopoly of the right, while Brazil faces polarized debates after Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy. A left-wing seminar with delegates from 39 countries reflected the 2026 Brazilian electoral scenario.

item.title: Congresso promulga aposentadoria especial para agentes de saúde após três meses de espera
item.description: The Brazilian Congress enacted a constitutional amendment establishing special retirement for community health agents (ACS) and disease control agents (ACE), with minimum ages of 57 for women and 60 for men, requiring 25 years of contribution and job performance. The measure is classified by the economic team as part of the 'bomb agenda' and is expected to increase by R$3 billion per year the financial shortfall in pension systems. The enactment follows months of delay and may lead to a Supreme Court lawsuit if no fiscal compensation is provided.

item.title: Congresso promulga fim da escala 6x1 nesta sexta-feira e abre contagem para jornada menor
item.description: The Brazilian Congress enacted a constitutional amendment ending the 6x1 shift and reducing the maximum weekly work hours from 44 to 40, with no salary cuts. The change takes effect in two stages: two months after enactment, the limit drops to 42 hours, and one year later, to 40 hours. President Lula hailed the move as a historic achievement, while the new rules preserve benefits such as overtime and time compensation.

item.title: Jogo está empatado, mas juiz favorece time de Flávio
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula are technically tied in the race for the Planalto, according to Datafolha. Despite Flávio's strategic endorsements, the PT's aggressive campaign and the approval of the 6x1 scale balanced the race. TSE judge Kassio Nunes Marques has been accused of favoring Flávio with controversial decisions.

item.title: Entenda o impasse entre governistas sobre maioridade penal que travou votação da PEC da Segurança no Senado
item.description: Dispute among government senators led Davi Alcolumbre to postpone the PEC da Segurança vote, which Lula intended to use in his campaign. Camilo Santana proposed lowering the age of criminal responsibility to 16 for heinous crimes, against Lula's allies.

item.title: Fim da escala 6x1: com promulgação, trabalhador começa a ter 2 folgas por semana este ano; veja regra
item.description: With the enactment of the PEC ending the 6x1 work schedule, Brazilian workers will gain two paid weekly rest days, and the workweek will be reduced from 44 to 40 hours in two stages. Public servants, individual entrepreneurs, and essential service workers are excluded from the rule. The federal government is preparing a decree to regulate the new legislation.

item.title: A primeira pesquisa para presidente feita totalmente após o fim da escala 6x1, pauta de Lula
item.description: Quaest will release on Wednesday (21) a second-round poll between Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), conducted after the Senate approved the end of the 6x1 work schedule. The survey, featuring 2,154 interviews and a ±2 percentage point margin of error, will be published by OGLOBO and TV Globo, reflecting the electoral race following labor reforms.

item.title: Lula na Globo: o que disse o candidato na 2ª entrevista à emissora
item.description: In a TV Globo interview, re-election candidate Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva expressed support for lowering the age of criminal responsibility for heinous crimes and advocated for Supreme Court reform. Lula is trailing Flávio Bolsonaro by three percentage points according to the BBC News Brasil polling aggregator. The runoff is scheduled for October 25.

item.title: Campanha de Lula reclama da Meta a observadores internacionais
item.description: Lula's campaign complained to Meta about asymmetric treatment favoring Flávio Bolsonaro, presenting complaints to international observers and the TSE, which ordered equal treatment for both campaigns.

item.title: Nikolas divulga vídeo de IA com Flávio bebendo e disparando míssil
item.description: Federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) posted an AI-generated video showing presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) drinking, firing guns, launching a missile, and wearing the presidential sash, accompanied by the song Free Bird by Lynyrd Skynyrd, a band historically linked to controversial symbols like the Confederate flag.

item.title: Lula liga Flávio a Canella, preso pela PF, durante sabatina na “Globo”
item.description: During a live interview on TV Globo, President Lula linked Congressman Márcio Canella, arrested by the Federal Police, to Flávio Bolsonaro, highlighting their closeness. Lula also criticized the Supreme Court crisis, claiming the far right tries to shift responsibility for Moraes' case. Canella was detained preventively in the Unha e Carne operation.

item.title: Datafolha: Flávio tem 59% dos votos válidos entre não alinhados, contra 41% de Lula
item.description: A Datafolha poll released on October 15, 2026 shows Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leading with 59% of valid votes among unaligned voters, against 41% for President Lula (PT). The survey highlights a polarized electoral scenario.

item.title: Lula diz ser a favor de reduzir maioridade penal para crimes hediondos
item.description: President Lula stated support for lowering the criminal majority age to 16 in cases of heinous crimes during a TV Globo interview. He opposed including the measure in the Public Security PEC but reaffirmed his stance on reducing criminal liability age in specific situations. The declaration represents a shift from the historical position of the PT on the issue.

item.title: Lula defende crescimento contra dívida e descarta corte de gastos
item.description: Lula reiterates he will not cut social spending to reduce debt, defending economic growth as the path to fiscal balance. He disagrees with the central bank on spending cuts and prioritizes protecting the poor.

item.title: Lula diz que Vorcaro alegou perseguição política em reunião
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) stated in an interview with TV Globrand that Daniel Vorcaro, founder of Banco Master, claimed political persecution during a meeting at the presidential palace in December 2024. Lula emphasized it was an investigation, not persecution, noting other bank executives also reached out during financial crises. Banco Master was liquidated by the Central Bank in November 2025 following market suspicions of irregularities.

item.title: Deputado diz que tarifa zero prometida por Lula custará R$ 16 bi e é apenas primeiro passo
item.description: Federal congressman Jilmar Tatto (PT-SP) estimates that the proposed free public transport fares on weekends will cost around R$ 16 billion per year. The measure, supported by Lula, is presented as just the first step of a broader agenda to reduce costs for the population.

item.title: Kassio estuda estender período de impedimento no caso Master após mensagens sugerirem favores de Vorcaro
item.description: STF Minister Kassio Nunes Marques considers extending his recusal in the Master case after messages suggesting favors from Daniel Vorcaro. The investigation points to potential undue advantages granted by the former banker during court proceedings.

item.title: Lula diz que não sabia que Bolsa Família passou quase 4 anos sem reajuste
item.description: President Lula told TV Globo he was unaware that the Bolsa Família program had gone nearly four years without an adjustment, calling the situation inexplicable. He ordered the benefit increase as soon as he learned of the lack of correction and announced the first adjustment since taking office, just 17 days before the first-round vote. Lula also decided to compensate for the years the benefit went without updates.

item.title: “PCC e CV são terroristas para a comunidade brasileira”, diz Lula
item.description: In a TV Globra interview, President Lula stated that the PCC and Red Command are terrorist factions for the Brazilian community, diverging from the U.S. classification that labels them as threats to the state. While Lula acknowledged cooperation proposals to the Trump administration, he rejected the terrorism designation imposed by the U.S.

item.title: TSE determina que governo Lula apresente dados sobre gastos com publicidade
item.description: In a unanimous ruling, the TSE ordered the Lula administration to provide detailed data on advertising expenditures from 2023 through the first half of 2026. Filed by the PL, the measure aims to check whether institutional advertising spending during the 2026 election period exceeded the average of previous years, a practice prohibited by election law.

item.title: Lula na TV Globo: candidato destaca feitos do governo, tenta se afastar da crise do STF e perde oportunidade de sinalizar ajuste fiscal
item.description: Lula highlighted government achievements and tried to distance himself from the STF crisis, but missed the opportunity to signal fiscal adjustments. In an interview with TV Globo, he admitted not fulfilling all promises and blamed damage inherited from Bolsonaro.

item.title: Lula diz que aumento da dívida pública preocupa e que solução para problema fiscal é fazer economia crescer
item.description: Lula acknowledges concern over rising public debt but argues that the solution is not to cut spending that harms the poor, but to stimulate economic growth. He advocates credit and microeconomy policies to boost income circulation among low-income groups.

item.title: Lula diz que não sabia que Bolsa Família ficou 3 anos sem reajuste
item.description: President Lula claimed he was unaware that Bolsa Família had gone three years without adjustment, justifying the recent measure by citing fiscal space and primary surplus. The adjustment, announced 17 days before the first round, raised the floor from R$ 600 to R$ 691, with an estimated cost of R$ 5.8 billion in 2026 and R$ 22 billion in 2027.

item.title: Lula defende redução da maioridade penal para crimes hediondos e reforma do Judiciário
item.description: President Lula advocated for lowering the age of criminal responsibility for heinous crimes and judicial reform during an interview with TV Globo, highlighting achievements of his third term such as the Tax Reform and the end of the 6×1 scale. He pledged to strengthen the fight against organized crime and tied the creation of the Ministry of Public Security to the approval of the PEC in Congress.

item.title: O que é crime hediondo, categoria em que Lula admite reduzir a maioridade penal na Globo
item.description: Lula supports lowering the age of criminal responsibility to 16 only for heinous crimes, aligning with Camilo Santana's proposal during the PEC da Segurança debates. He stated this in a TV Globo interview, reinforcing his stance on stricter criminal legislation for serious offenses.

item.title: Lula diz que não sabia que Bolsa Família não teve reajuste e se esquiva sobre caráter eleitoral
item.description: Lula stated he was unaware of the lack of adjustment to the Bolsa Família and that the recent announcement followed his discovery of the situation. In an interview with TV Globo, he avoided commenting on the electoral nature of the measure.

item.title: Lógico que estou preocupado com aumento da dívida pública, diz Lula
item.description: President Lula expressed concern about the growing public debt and advocated for economic growth as a way to address the fiscal challenge. He emphasized the need for policies that promote sustainable development to reduce indebtedness.

item.title: Lula diz que desconhecia falta de aumento no Bolsa Família antes da eleição
item.description: President Lula stated he was unaware of the lack of adjustment to the Bolsa Família during his third term and denied that the measure taken before the first round had an electoral character. He emphasized that the decision was made by government technicians without the intention of influencing the election.

item.title: Lula diz ser favorável à redução da maioridade penal para 16 anos para crimes hediondos
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva stated his support for lowering the age of criminal responsibility to 16 for heinous crimes, but ruled out including the proposal in the public security reform. He emphasized the need to discuss the matter separately and carefully.

item.title: Lula diz que Brasil deve chegar a um acordo com os EUA sobre tarifaço
item.description: Lula states that Brazil needs to negotiate an agreement with the US to prevent tariff increases on Brazilian products. He emphasizes the importance of maintaining balanced trade relations between the countries. The statement was made during a press conference on TV Globo.

item.title: Conselho dos Direitos Humanos pede a órgão da OEA monitoramento da eleição após decisões de Kassio no TSE
item.description: The National Council of Human Rights (CNDH) sent a letter to the IACHR alleging biased judicial decisions by Minister Kassio at the STF during the 2026 election runoff, claiming unequal application of electoral law. The council requests OAS monitoring of Brazil's electoral process.

item.title: Explicação de chefe da PF sobre festa de Vorcaro não me convenceu, diz Lula
item.description: President Lula criticized the director-general of the Federal Police, Andrei Rodrigues, for attending a party organized by Daniel Vorcaro abroad, stating that the explanation provided was not convincing. Lula emphasized that such involvement should not have occurred and questioned the transparency of the act.

item.title: A nova pesquisa Real Time Big Data sobre a disputa Flávio x Lula no segundo turno
item.description: A new Real Time Big Data survey will be released on October 20th, updating voter intentions for Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro ahead of the runoff on October 25th, including rejection rates, voter conviction levels, and potential vote shifts. The poll will also assess public opinion on proposals such as building federal prisons, labeling crime factions as narcoterrorist organizations, and lowering the age of majority.

item.title: Lula muda de posição e diz que defende redução de maioridade penal para 16 anos
item.description: President Lula shifted his stance and now supports lowering the criminal majority age from 18 to 16, amid debates over the Security PEC in the Senate. His position contrasts with PL candidate Flávio Bolsonaro, who previously defended the measure, and aligns with a poll showing a technical tie in voting intent. Lula also criticized Supreme Court justices linked to the former Banco Master owner but emphasized non-interference in the judiciary crisis.
